worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.summary: Summon a ring of sharp leaves that encircles the target in a cutting vortex; every beat cuts it and may fling leaf flecks into its eyes, cutting its accuracy.
worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.use.0: Trap the target in a lasting cutting area
worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.use.2: Keep rolling for accuracy drops with leaf flecks
worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.descriptio: Each beat deals %1$s special damage; every beat has a %2$s chance to drop accuracy by %3$s stages (settled at most once per target).
The vortex is %1$s blocks wide, lasts %2$s and cuts once every %3$s, throwing about %4$s leaves each beat.
It can be raised up to %1$s blocks away; tight wrap is currently %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.preference: On: radius ×0.7, per-beat power ×1.35 and +15% blind chance, but +2 ticks wind-up and +4 ticks cooldown. Off: radius ×1.3 covers more ground, but per-beat power ×0.8 and the base blind chance.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values raise the vortex from further away.
On: it prefers a target with other enemies nearby so the lasting cuts catch more. Off: it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
On: it may leave a hold position to place the vortex. Off: it only casts when already in range.
